messages.subject: Corporate Affairs Executive | Government Relations, ESG & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Gill,

Melbury Wood's specialist work across corporate affairs, public affairs, communications and reputation leadership makes this a particularly strong fit for my executive background.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, corporate and external affairs, ESG and social performance, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major natural-resources operation.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where government engagement, regulatory strategy, reputation, stakeholder confidence and responsible growth must be managed as an integrated executive agenda. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, while I remain internationally mobile for global mandates.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for relevant current or future searches across corporate affairs, government relations, public affairs, external affairs, sustainability and country leadership.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
